crossRefs.note: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in…
Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
translations.bsb: Asher’s food will be rich; he shall provide royal delicacies.
translations.kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
translations.asv: Out of the Asher his bread shall be fat, And he shall yield royal dainties.
